title: Task
description: Result of agent.start, agent.get (adds activity and evidence), agent.stop, and agent.active tasks[] (m3-agent §2, §4).

kind.description: codex_mcp: legacy, read only (tasks stored before M9 dropped the Codex provider; agent.start refuses it).

mode.description: m5-chat §3: an MCP kind asked in-app (the host runs the CLI); absent otherwise.

everSharedNames.description: m9 §1.2 sticky exposure mark: true once the task has shared names (at start or after widening); never cleared. Used wherever a writer's exposure matters (AI notes and cards).

webTainted.description: m9 §5.5 web-taint mark: true once web-derived text (a web_lookup result, a research summary through get_findings, or an AI card, note or title whose writer was tainted or unmarked) was released to this task; set in that same transaction, never cleared. Absent on tasks stored before m9 P4c (false).

webLookups.description: m9 §7: web_lookup calls this task made (counted when not refused), against grant.limits.webLookups.

scriptProposals.description: m9 §5.1 rule 8: propose_script calls charged to this task (refused proposals included; a call that returned the pending plan is not charged), against grant.limits.scripts. Absent until the first one.

clientSession.description: m5-chat §3, headless tasks only: the Claude Code session ID the next ask resumes (a Codex thread ID on a legacy task, read only).

client.description: codex: legacy, read only (a task paired before M9; agent.pair refuses it now).

activity.description: agent.get only: the last 100 task events.

evidence.description: agent.get only: this task's own diagnostic evidence as the model received it.

grant.description: m3 §2, changed by m9 §1.3. agent.start without a grant builds it from ai.permissions; fields m9 added are optional on a given grant (see on, changes from canRequestChanges, scripts and web off). The host always writes every field.

diagnostics.description: m9 §17.2: the last three are administrator checks (tier admin): usable only with admin.

changes.description: Wins over canRequestChanges; without it canRequestChanges:true means ask.

admin.description: m9 §17.1: administrator rights (do.admin). Absent = false, on a stored grant and on a given one (the pairing panel).

permissionsRevision.description: The ai.permissions revision the grant was built (or last widened) from; 0 for a given grant.

canRequestChanges.description: Derived and read-only (changes != off), for old readers. Accepted on a given grant without changes (legacy).
